title: gettext force_plural
notes: As gettext, but the catalog is parsed with ParseOptions::force_plural, giving the locale's plural rule as a function instead of the header's formula.
details: The crate's parser for the Plural-Forms formula splits at && before it splits at ?:, so the standard Russian formula yields the wrong form (5 messages gets form 0). The option replaces the formula; the two rules (en, ru) are written in the adapter, outside the timed call.
